notes.title: Game Update!
notes.notes:
Hello MDL lovers and community! 

We've changed a few things in your favorite BL game, including:
   ・added character voice,
　・the game now partially supports usage of gaming controllers,
　・various bug fixes, UI, scenario, system improvements.

We hope you'll enjoy replaying My Dangerous Life and we also hope you'll keep your eyes peeled for our upcoming Dating Visual Novel, Doki Doki House, that was recently announced on our social media pages! Check it out if you haven't already, steamy romance is in the works at Giiku Games and you're invited to join!

Stay hydrated!
GG

notes.title: We have Community Items now!!
notes.notes:
Hello there!

We have great news for you!

Our team has worked hard to bring you some extra excitement while playing the game - you can now get card drops that you may craft into badges, as well as receive background wallpapers for your Steam profile AND really cute emoticons with the boys to use in your Steam chats! 

Hope you enjoy!

xoxo
Giiku Team

notes.title: Updated Game Launcher
notes.notes:
Dear players,

with the update today - 23rd of February - we included a new launcher for the game. 

With this we try to provide you additional information about the game and our other titles which are in the making and might also will appeal to your interest.

Besides that we wish you a continuing blast with MyDangerousLife.

Your 
GiikuGames Team

notes.title: Launching next week!
notes.notes:
Hello peeps!

The time has finally come - after much anticipation and excitement we are proud to announce that we'll be launching this gem of a visual novel on the 23rd of July!
You love cute Anime characters, thrilling romances and just a pinch of danger? Then this is the game for you! Become part of our amazing community and never miss out on an update or cute comic again! We'd love to hear how you think the story will unfold and who your favourite romantic interest is!

Here, you'll get a first sneak peek into Hinata's daily struggles with his carefree roommate Alan...the boy with the perfect smile that might just be a little bit too perfect to be true.
